purpose: Compare mRNAutilus (the method behind the collaborator's paper) against this project's objective on sequences this project has already scored, without changing this project's code first.
declared_before_any_number_was_seen: Rank statistics only. Their config.yaml carries 'avg' normalisers (0.0212, -0.613, 1.503), so their head outputs are not physical units and absolute values are not comparable to hours.

Their half-life head is Saluki-trained on in-cell decay; the Leppek records measure in-solution degradation. On that test set this project is in-domain and mRNAutilus is not. This is not a symmetric comparison and must not be reported as one.
The Leppek records carry no declared CDS boundaries, so the three-segment tokeniser requires a declared ORF-finding step: longest ATG..in-frame-stop with no internal stop.
The narrow-bin pairwise concordance metric and its bin edges are the ones already frozen in stability_feature_ablation_v1; chance is 0.50.

their_artifacts_not_redistributed.policy: Only URLs and hashes are pinned, matching how RiboNN weights and Rfam sources are handled. No mRNAutilus code or weights are vendored into this repository.
their_artifacts_not_redistributed.strict_load_verified: 399 state-dict entries, 399 after prefix strip, 0 missing, 0 unexpected, 148.1M parameters

environment_adaptations: torch >= 2.6 defaults weights_only=True and their loader does not pass it; patched at the call site in the comparison script only. The checkpoint is the authors' own file at the pinned hash, whose strict load this project verified.

flash-attn 2.8.3 made fp32 rotary position indices unconditional, so RotaryEmbedding no longer accepts pos_idx_in_fp32; verified equivalent in the flash-attn source and the kwarg dropped. Original preserved as attention.py.orig.

flash-attn >= 2.7 appends used_seqlens_in_batch to unpad_input's return; their call unpacks four values. The fifth is informational and unused by their code, so it is discarded. Verified in flash_attn/bert_padding.py.

run_a_same_pool_both_methods.sequences: this project's reference plus the 512-member whole-transcript pool
run_a_same_pool_both_methods.pool_regenerated_deterministically: build_pool at the frozen seed, then assemble_designed; all 512 transcript_sha256_rna values must match the stored run or the script aborts
run_a_same_pool_both_methods.comparison: Spearman of each of their heads against this project's predicted in-solution half-life, and against transcript GC fraction

run_b_held_out_measured_records.records: the 123 held-out Leppek in-solution half-life records, the same set used for external_validation_leppek_v1
run_b_held_out_measured_records.cds_inference: longest ATG..in-frame-stop, no internal stop; 123 of 123 records yielded an ORF
run_b_held_out_measured_records.layouts: 49 distinct (5'UTR length, CDS length) layouts, because their scorer slices at fixed offsets; the language model is loaded once and reused across all of them
run_b_held_out_measured_records.metric: Spearman plus pairwise concordance in the frozen measured-fold-difference bins
